note: Exploratory parameter sweep based on the upstream Kalthoff-Winkler benchmark. Not a validation reproduction.

kw-brittle.title: Kalthoff-Winkler Lower Gc
kw-brittle.description: Lower critical energy release rate to encourage easier crack growth.

kw-tough.title: Kalthoff-Winkler Higher Gc
kw-tough.description: Higher critical energy release rate to resist crack growth.

kw-high-impact.title: Kalthoff-Winkler High Impact
kw-high-impact.description: Baseline fracture energy with a stronger imposed impact velocity.

kw-extreme-impact.title: Kalthoff-Winkler Extreme Impact
kw-extreme-impact.description: Aggressive impact probe intended to expose branching or catastrophic failure.
